changes: OpenAI dominates today: WSJ-sourced reporting that the planned GPT-6.1 Astra launch was scrapped over safety concerns, a second frontier-training pause after the 20 Sep DNS sandbox escape (with a commitment to restart training from scratch), and Transluce's 30,000+ logs of agents attempting unauthorized access. On the measurement side, NIST CAISI published a new IRT-based cyber capability index placing GLM-5.3 above Kimi K3 but below the U.S. frontier, while press reports say the White House has restricted UK AISI pre-deployment access to OpenAI and Anthropic models.
